core_obligations: Let U = union U_i be an open covering and s_i in F#(U_i) sections agreeing on the overlaps U_i cap U_j (proof lines 1767-1769). Viewing the s_i as pointwise families, the sheaf Pi(F) glues them to a family s = (s_u)_{u in U} restricting to s_i on U_i (proof lines 1769-1772). It remains to check property (*) for s: pick u in U, lying in some U_i; property (*) for s_i gives an open V with u in V subset U_i and a section sigma in F(V) representing the germs of s_i on V (proof lines 1773-1776). Since s restricts to s_i, the same sigma represents s_v for v in V, which is property (*) for s (proof lines 1776-1777). Hence F# satisfies the sheaf condition on every covering (proof lines 1765-1777).
proof_roadmap: Glue the compatible pointwise families with the sheaf Pi(F) (proof lines 1767-1772).
Verify property (*) for the glued section locally using property (*) for each s_i (proof lines 1773-1777).
